import zipfile,subprocess,os,tempfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
name='testdata/poc/poc-f2fe4473b6f4d2322e56d507f6d3a2e4f910b529e65cdb93f28e3cf598c47be8'
base=z.read(name)
for cut in [0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128]:
    d=base[:max(1,len(base)-cut)]
    p='/tmp/poc2'
    open(p,'wb').write(d)
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p,'/workspace/analysis.json'],cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('cut',cut,'len',len(d),'rc',r.returncode)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print(r.stdout.splitlines()[-1])
        break
PY
